args.evidence: Tx power fell from ~1.77 dBm average 13 Oct to -1.6 dBm average 26 Oct while Tx bias increased from ~65 mA to ~66 mA; Rx power fell correspondingly from ~-10.8 dBm to ~-14.16 dBm triggering RX_LOW_WARNING at 2026-10-25 19:00 UTC, and pre-FEC BER rose. OTDR from A shows end at 53.617 km with last reflective at 52.612 km and no excess loss events; OTDR from B shows end at 53.615 km, confirming fibre integrity with no break, macrobend or splice degradation. Site notes show A-ODF cleaned 21 Oct and SC-03 accessed 18 Oct with no subsequent fibre fault. The correlated Tx power loss with rising bias and unchanged fibre loss indicates A-TX degradation.
